Deliver reproducible analysis records.

steps.instruction:
加位元後誤差不再下降時，查漂移或失調主導；若邊界突然偏大，查飽和而非量化。
對照「滿刻度介面」的名義結果，分別建立物理故障與量測／紀錄偏移兩個解釋。指定一項能分辨它們的獨立觀察，再依證據選擇處置。先估各誤差來源再選ADC解析度；漂移主導時優先校準而非無限制增位元。
本階段必須重驗：建立ADC半LSB與漂移的最壞誤差界，說明增加ADC位元不能消除元件漂移。
steps.instructionEn:
An error floor after more bits suggests drift/offset; large endpoint errors suggest saturation.
Against the nominal Full-scale interface result, build competing physical-fault and sensing/logging-offset explanations. Name an independent observation that separates them and select the disposition from evidence. Estimate each source before choosing ADC resolution; calibrate when drift dominates.
Reverify this criterion: Budget half-LSB and drift errors, showing why more ADC bits do not remove device drift.
steps.observation: 證據能區分兩個成因；不足時明列待測量，不把猜測當結案。加位元後誤差不再下降時，查漂移或失調主導；若邊界突然偏大，查飽和而非量化。
steps.observationEn: Evidence separates causes; insufficient evidence remains an open measurement need. An error floor after more bits suggests drift/offset; large endpoint errors suggest saturation.
steps.failure: 相同警報直接等同同一故障，沒有獨立觀察。
steps.failureEn: Equating the same alert with the same cause without an independent observation.

steps.instruction:
